name: Two MegaMen a side (epic #167's spike)
result: With a side's second MegaMan's keys written at the battle loop's key copy (0x08012DFC) by the loop's iteration, both GBAs' battles agree at every iteration: the research harness over a whole battle (every T1, T3 and T4 object, AI data, NaviStats, hand and random number compared; nothing apart beyond BN6's own 1v1's fields) and the pair under --dev rollbench,arena2v2 (489 iterations, 0 apart, 11 rollbacks the same); one key flipped on one GBA parts them (325 apart). The feasibility study's one-frame skew was its harness: every mode it ran was mode 1, which scheduled the partner by each core's own frame counter, a frame or two apart at the same iteration.
meaning: BN6's engine runs two MegaMen a side alike on both GBAs; a partner's keys must enter by the battle's iteration. Under full rules BN5's chip AI gave both of side 0's MegaMen one AI data block, which the flag keeps to the first.
